[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
David Glasgow's existing profile gives his birth as 20 July 1744. A Findmypast parish transcript indexes his baptism on 29 July 1744 at Ayr, Ayrshire, and names Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland as his parents.<ref name="FMP">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_692915698&tab=this David Glasgow, R_692915698] (reviewed 23 October 2026), baptism 29 July 1744, Ayr; parents Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland. The transcript gives birth year 1744 but no separate birth day. Original register image uninspected.</ref> The transcript does not establish or contradict 20 July as his birth date, which needs a separate source check. The named father may be [[Glasgow-3457|Robert Glasgow]], but identifying that adult profile remains possible rather than proved. Mary Borland's identification and any parent attachment need separate review.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-3457]] is assessed at 85% (probable). David's Ayr baptism of 29 July 1744 names Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/4400472). Robert [[Glasgow-3457]] is defined only as that father; the earlier 55% was held down by [[Robert-3457]]'s unsupported 1724 birth and the possibility that he duplicated another Robert/Borland family. R1 (5 November) resolved that duplication: [[Robert-3457]] is the Irvine shipmaster [[Robert-2474]]. The full transcripts now add David's elder brother Robert, baptised at Ayr on 16 November 1740 to the same couple (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/16346646). Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland baptised John at Irvine on 10 October 1736 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/2461718) and again on 5 October 1738 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/8126993), then Robert at Ayr on 16 November 1740 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/16346646) and David at Ayr on 29 July 1744 (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/4400472). The child-to-father link is the literal parent clause of a record-defined father, raised from 55% to 85% probable.

Robert-3457's 1724 birth remains unsupported and conflicts with the identity with Robert-2474 (baptised 1716); the vital field is not changed. Ayr and Irvine are separate parishes. The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index; where the same entry was already held it is not counted twice. Index transcripts only; original registers uninspected.

In this earlier review, the father [[Glasgow-3457]] is assessed at 55% (possible). The 29 July 1744 Ayr baptism transcript names Robert Glasgow and Mary Borland, but it does not establish that its Robert is the selected profile.<ref name="FMP" /> A paternal age about twenty is plausible if the inherited 1724 birth is sound; that birth is unsupported, and this account may duplicate another Robert/Borland family.
